english.title: Driver of vehicle to give details after accident involving aircraft at Luton Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) at Luton Airport an accident having occurred involving an aircraft and being the driver of a vehicle involved, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, the registration number or identification marks of the vehicle and details of the accident to an airport official or a constable or any other person having reasonable grounds for requiring them as soon as practicable but, in any case, no later than 24 hours after the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3.9(b) and 7.1 of the London Luton Airport Byelaws 2005.
